items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine Interview, 1964-04-25
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Letty? Paoletti. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Well, I played out there all the time. ... I never heard of this band.

ctx.x: Violin and an alto. An alto. An alto.

Well, he should have been from the Seventh Ward. You know what they call the Seventh Ward? The what? They changed the word line so many times. No, no, no. You know what they call it around St. Bernard Avenue? They call that the Can't Tell Ward. Tell him. I don't still get it. Tell him. Along about St. Bernard Avenue, they call that the Can't Tell Ward, because you can't tell if they're white or colored. What about Paoletti's band? Who? Paoletti. Baoletti? Paoletti. Paoletti. Paoletti. Paoletti. Letty? Paoletti.…
Well, I played out there all the time. I had bands out there regular. You played at the West End? Well, I never heard of this band.
